verdict.rationale: Docs mention traces can be 'exported... via the UI or API' (langsmith-docs-2), implying some export capability, but there is no evidence of dedicated bulk-export tooling to blob storage (S3/GCS) or data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery) as a documented feature. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-export docs/API endpoints for blob storage or data warehouse destinations, scheduling/automation of exports, and any independent confirmation of this workflow.
